arguments.command: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1; npm run check 2>&1 | tail -25; echo EXIT=$?; grep -rn "install-agent-hooks\|hooks.test" --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git . | head; printf 'release: v0.35.1\n' | npx --no -- commitlint; echo CL=$?
